why: The red direction of the corpus runner itself, and the half that matters more: a runner that cannot tell a failing fixture from a passing one reports green for nothing. The application reports the release channel as `beta` where its frozen contract requires `stable` (commands/release.cjs), so criterion E1-02 must be `fail` while E1-01 stays `pass` — a MIXED outcome, chosen so the fixture cannot pass by accident and cannot fail for an incidental reason. The verdict is FAIL with exit 1 and NO `gateFailed`: this fixture declares no gates, so a `gateFailed` marker appearing here would mean the product attributed a criterion failure to the build. It embodies no numbered defect class from brief section 7; those belong to stories 6.2, 6.3 and 6.4.
